name: Latvia

authorities.competent_authority: ZVA (Zāļu valsts aģentūra, State Agency of Medicines of Latvia); coordinates the national assessment and issues the decision.
authorities.ethics: ZVA assigns a medicinal-product clinical-trial ethics committee, which assesses the ethical aspects and prepares the Part II assessment report.
authorities.data_protection_authority: Data State Inspectorate (Datu valsts inspekcija); its contact details are required in the main consent set.
authorities.fee: Not stated in the Latvia guides (DECISIONS.md, Missing).
authorities.national_guidance: Overview Part II Requirements in a Clinical Trial Application, Latvian Local Requirements, version 2.0 (4 February 2025); Cabinet Regulation No. 192, Clinical Trials of Medicinal Products for Human Use (26 March 2024); Law on the Rights of Patients; Clinical Trials Regulation Q&A version 7.3 (July 2026).

answer_languages_note: One package language: Latvian. Participant-facing documents and recruitment material for participants and doctors must be in Latvian. The Latvia overview imposes no general Latvian rule on administrative documents (K1, M1, M2, N1, O1, P1, P2, R1, S1); English EU templates are accepted or recommended. Forms are answered in Latvian by default, matching the supplied Latvian variable sheet; English is an option (DECISIONS.md D1). M2 uses the English EudraLex template.

language_rules.rule: Latvian is required for participant-facing documents in Part II and for recruitment material intended for participants and doctors. The wording must be understandable to the expected population. The Latvia overview does not impose a general Latvian translation rule on administrative documents.
language_rules.non_latvian_speakers: If a participant group cannot understand Latvian, plan a suitable additional language version and consent process rather than relying on an unapproved ad hoc translation. An interpreter may be used in the witness pathway; the witness route never solves a language barrier.
language_rules.russian: Not required and not mentioned: none of the 11 Latvia guide pages refers to Russian or another minority language. Russian versions are planned only under the non-Latvian-speaker rule above, as additional approved versions (titles ending _LV_ru) alongside the Latvian documents (DECISIONS.md D2).
language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Latvian by default; English accepted (DECISIONS.md D1).

study_facts_country_specific.population.non_latvian_speakers: Will people who cannot understand Latvian be enrolled? (additional approved language version and consent process; DECISIONS.md D2)
study_facts_country_specific.recruitment.doctor_facing_material: Are letters or other materials addressed to doctors used to refer potential participants? (Latvian, submitted as K2)
study_facts_country_specific.consent.separate_screening: Does healthy-volunteer screening involve research procedures or collection of data or samples before main enrolment? (screening consent scope or separate screening consent)
study_facts_country_specific.consent.capacity_assessment_form: Does the protocol use a structured capacity assessment? (approved process or form included)
study_facts_country_specific.trial.low_intervention: Is it a low-intervention trial? (insurance minimum 12 instead of 48 minimum monthly wages)

documents.language_rule: The Latvia overview does not require the procedure form to be translated into Latvian. Answered in Latvian by default (package answer language, supplied Latvian variable sheet); English is accepted (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure template, version 2.0 (adopted January 2026; applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026). Latvia requires this EU template.

documents.content: Identification, first contact, recruiters, pre-screening, consent discussions, time to decide and the national variations for Latvia. Every population pathway in the plan (minors 0-13 and 14-17, adults unable to consent, impartial witness, emergency) needs its section completed; each recruitment item (LV-K2) has its channel and purpose explained here.

national_fields.v105: Required in Latvia: in Latvian, state that every advertisement, invitation, social-media item, script, leaflet, poster, video text, doctor letter or other material used in Latvia to recruit or refer potential participants is in Latvian (materials intended for participants and for doctors) and is submitted under Recruitment arrangements as a final blank version, not signed; give the channel and purpose of each item. For healthy volunteers, describe identification, first contact, record access, pre-screening and who approaches volunteers, including any identifiable patient lists or outside pre-screening provider.
national_fields.v108: Required in Latvia: in Latvian, state that the participant documents are in Latvian and understandable to the intended population; that the participant receives adequate time to consider the information and can ask questions; that the competent adult participant (or the authorised decision-maker) and the person conducting the consent interview sign and date the consent before any trial-specific procedure (the CTIS copy is blank and unsigned) and that a copy of the signed consent documentation is given; that if a participant group cannot understand Latvian, an additional approved language version and consent process is used, never an unapproved ad hoc translation; and that new information that may affect willingness to continue is given promptly and voluntary written consent to continue is obtained.
national_fields.v110: Required in Latvia when adults unable to consent are included: in Latvian, describe how capacity is assessed, by whom, when it is reassessed and how fluctuating or temporary incapacity is handled; that under the Law on the Rights of Patients the decision-maker for a patient unable to express their wishes and not under a relevant court arrangement is the patient's authorised person, spouse, partner or closest relative, giving written consent, and only if the patient has not previously objected to trial participation; that for a patient under guardianship or trusteeship written consent is given by the lawful representative, or by the guardian together with the patient according to the court-defined restriction of legal capacity; that the site verifies and records the decision-maker's authority before consent and does not enrol while authority is uncertain; that the participant receives information suited to their capacity and an objection (verbal or non-verbal) is respected and cannot be overridden by the representative; and that the participant's own written consent is obtained with the current adult Latvian information as soon as capacity is regained.
national_fields.v114: Required in Latvia when minors are included: in Latvian, describe the two national pathways: under 14, written consent of the legal representative, with the child informed according to age and maturity and the younger child's own agreement sought where appropriate (a young child's signature never replaces the legal representative's consent); from 14 until the 18th birthday, written consent of both the minor and the legal representative (Cabinet Regulation No. 192; Law on the Rights of Patients). State who qualifies as legal representative under Latvian law, how authority is documented at the site and how shared custody, guardianship, disagreement or missing documentation are handled; do not state a universal two-parent signature rule without a trial-specific legal basis. State that a capable adolescent's refusal means no enrolment and that a younger child's verbal or behavioural objection is taken seriously (Article 32 CTR); that information is given by investigators or team members trained or experienced in working with children; and that consent is renewed when the child reaches 14 (minor's own written consent added) and when the participant reaches 18 (adult consent with the current adult version).
national_fields.v117: Required in Latvia when an impartial witness may be needed: in Latvian, state that the route is used only when a participant who can consent cannot write (not for a language barrier, which needs information in a language the participant understands and a qualified interpreter, and not instead of a legal representative); how capacity, inability to write, witness impartiality (independent of the trial and of the study team, conflicts checked), accessible information, questions, voluntary agreement and copies are handled; that the person conducting the interview and the witness sign and date, the participant signs if physically able or the approved alternative means is recorded; and that withdrawal does not require a handwritten request.
national_fields.v121: Required in Latvia when emergency enrolment is used: in Latvian, explain each Article 35 condition for the exact condition and therapeutic window; who confirms eligibility, how prior objections and available representatives are checked, what is documented and how quickly the subsequent-consent team is contacted; that Latvia publishes no separate national emergency-consent form; that subsequent consent is sought without undue delay from the participant if able, otherwise from the legally designated representative, and from the participant directly when capacity is regained; and how refusal and withdrawal are handled for interventions, data and samples.

documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa K (Recruitment arrangements). Obligāts dokuments. Latvijā obligāti jāizmanto ES veidne „Recruitment and Informed Consent Procedure”, versija 2.0 (pieņemta 2026. gada janvārī; piemēro jauniem II daļas iesniegumiem no 2026. gada 1. septembra). Veidlapa nav jātulko latviski; šajā paketē atbildes sniedz latviešu valodā (angļu valoda ir pieļaujama, DECISIONS.md D1). Iesniedzot netiek parakstīta. Aprakstiet potenciālo dalībnieku identificēšanu, pirmo kontaktu, personas, kas piesaista dalībniekus, priekšatlasi, informētas piekrišanas sarunu, pārdomu laiku un Latvijas nacionālās prasības (national_fields). Katram piesaistīšanas materiālam norādiet kanālu un mērķi. Katram populācijas ceļam (nepilngadīgie 0–13 un 14–17 gadi, rīcībnespējīgi pieaugušie, objektīvs liecinieks, neatliekamā situācija) aizpildiet attiecīgo sadaļu; ja ceļš netiek izmantots, norādiet, ka tas nav piemērojams.

documents.name_en: Recruitment materials for participants and doctors
documents.trigger_text: Any advertisement, invitation, social-media item, script, leaflet, poster, video text, doctor letter or other material used to recruit or refer potential participants (including pre-screening scripts and invitation text for healthy volunteers).
documents.language_rule: Latvia requires materials intended for participants and doctors to be in Latvian.
documents.content: Final blank Latvian version of each item, not signed. The channel and purpose of each item are explained in K1.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa K (Recruitment arrangements). Nosacīts: katrs sludinājums, ielūgums, sociālo tīklu ieraksts, skripts, buklets, plakāts, video teksts, vēstule ārstiem vai cits materiāls, ko izmanto dalībnieku piesaistīšanai vai nosūtīšanai. Latviešu valodā (dalībniekiem un ārstiem paredzētie materiāli). Iesniedz galīgo tukšo versiju, bez paraksta. Katra materiāla kanālu un mērķi paskaidro K1. Viens dokuments katram materiālam.

documents.name_en: Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, one set per relevant population
documents.language_rule: Latvian, understandable to the expected population. If a participant group cannot understand Latvian, an additional approved language version (for example _LV_ru) and consent process are planned; no unapproved ad hoc translation (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.template_status: missing: no Latvian participant templates supplied; see participant_templates_missing and population_sets (every template "missing"), DECISIONS.md D14.
documents.content: Final blank Latvian information sheet and consent form for each relevant population, uploaded under Subject information and informed consent form. Concise and understandable; carries version and date, sponsor protocol number, EU CT number, study-centre name and address, data-controller identity, and contact details for ZVA, the assigned ethics committee and the Data State Inspectorate. The filename identifies the document type (for example adult, legal representative, 0 to 13 years, 14 to 17 years). Signed and dated only at enrolment by the participant or authorised decision-maker and the person conducting the consent interview.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa L (Subject information and informed consent form). Obligāts dokuments katrai attiecīgajai populācijai; galīgā tukšā latviešu versija, iesniedzot nav parakstīta. Kodolīgs un saprotams teksts. Norādiet versiju un datumu, sponsora protokola numuru, ES klīniskās izpētes (EU CT) numuru, pētījuma centra nosaukumu un adresi, datu pārziņa identitāti un Zāļu valsts aģentūras (ZVA), norīkotās ētikas komitejas un Datu valsts inspekcijas kontaktinformāciju. Faila nosaukumā norādiet dokumenta veidu (piemēram, pieaugušajiem, likumiskajam pārstāvim, 0–13 gadi, 14–17 gadi). Paraksta un datē tikai iekļaušanas brīdī dalībnieks vai pilnvarotā persona un persona, kas vada informētas piekrišanas sarunu. Latviešu veidne nav iesniegta: sagatavo pēc Latvijas vadlīnijām (drafting_rules) vai pielāgo atsauces dokumentu.

documents.trigger: population.healthy_volunteers or population.minors or population.adults_without_capacity or consent.emergency_enrolment or consent.impartial_witness_possible or pregnancy.participant_follow_up_beyond_main_consent or pregnancy.partner_follow_up or pregnancy.infant_follow_up or samples.future_use_outside_protocol or data.future_use_outside_protocol
documents.trigger_text: The trial includes minors, adults unable to consent, emergency enrolment, healthy volunteers, witness-assisted consent, pregnancy follow-up or optional future use.
documents.content: Separate or clearly adapted Latvian documents for each population-specific pathway. From age 14 a Latvian minor and the legal representative both give written consent. See population_sets and population_rules.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa L. Nosacīts: atsevišķi vai skaidri pielāgoti latviešu dokumenti, ja pētījumā iekļauj nepilngadīgos, rīcībnespējīgus pieaugušos, neatliekamā situācijā iekļautas personas, veselus brīvprātīgos, piekrišanu objektīva liecinieka klātbūtnē, grūtniecības novērošanu vai neobligātu turpmāku izmantošanu. No 14 gadu vecuma rakstisku piekrišanu dod gan nepilngadīgais, gan likumiskais pārstāvis. Iesniedzot nav parakstīti; paredziet pareizos paraksta un datuma laukus katram parakstītājam (dalībnieks, likumiskais pārstāvis, nepilngadīgais no 14 gadiem, liecinieks, persona, kas vada sarunu). Skatīt population_sets un population_rules.

documents.trigger_text: Diaries, safety cards, instruction leaflets, visit aids, questionnaires and similar items that explain participation or support conduct. Patient-facing instruments used to assess protocol endpoints belong with the protocol in Part I; their required Latvian translation is uploaded in Part II using the CTIS translation route of the current Q&A (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.content: Latvian, normally blank and unsigned at submission.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa. Nosacīts: dienasgrāmatas, drošības kartes, instrukciju bukleti, vizīšu palīglīdzekļi, anketas un līdzīgi materiāli, kas izskaidro dalību vai atbalsta pētījuma norisi; latviešu valodā, parasti tukši un neparakstīti. Pacientiem paredzētie instrumenti, ar kuriem novērtē protokola mērķa kritērijus, pieder pie protokola I daļā; to obligāto latviešu tulkojumu augšupielādē II daļā pa CTIS tulkojumu ceļu, kas aprakstīts aktuālajos jautājumos un atbildēs (nosaukums R2_Patient-facing document_<veids>_LV_lv, DECISIONS.md D7).

documents.language_rule: The recommended EudraLex CV template may be completed in English.

template.basis: EudraLex Investigator Curriculum Vitae template, version 3.6, September 2022 (recommended in Latvia)

documents.content: One dated CV for the principal investigator at each Latvian site, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator. States the physician's specialty, workplace and position, professional certificate number and validity, and the date, version and edition of Good Clinical Practice training. The GCP certificate is not uploaded unless requested. Only the principal investigator's CV is assessed. No signature specified, but the CV must be dated.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa M (Suitability of the investigator). Obligāts: viens datēts CV katram galvenajam pētniekam katrā Latvijas pētījuma centrā. Ieteicama EudraLex CV veidne; to var aizpildīt angļu valodā. CV jānorāda ārsta specialitāte, darbavieta un amats, profesionālā sertifikāta numurs un derīguma termiņš, kā arī labas klīniskās prakses (GCP) apmācības datums, versija un izdevums. GCP sertifikātu neaugšupielādē, ja vien to nepieprasa. Paraksts nav noteikts, bet CV jābūt datētam. Asistents aizpilda tikai pētījuma laukus; personas datus sniedz pētnieks.

documents.language_rule: The English EudraLex Declaration of Interest template is used.

template.basis: EudraLex Declaration of Interest template, version 1.2, September 2022 (mandatory in Latvia)

documents.content: One declaration per principal investigator, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator. Identifies the trial, investigator, institution, relevant interests and date. The template has no signature field; a separate signature is not required unless ZVA or the assigned ethics committee requests one.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa M (Suitability of the investigator). Obligāts: katram galvenajam pētniekam. Latvijā obligāti jāizmanto angļu valodas EudraLex interešu deklarācijas veidne. Jānorāda pētījums, pētnieks, iestāde, attiecīgās intereses un datums. Veidnē nav paraksta lauka; atsevišķs paraksts nav vajadzīgs, ja to nepieprasa ZVA vai norīkotā ētikas komiteja. Asistents aizpilda tikai pētījuma nosaukumu un ES pētījuma numuru.

documents.language_rule: The English EU template is accepted; answered in Latvian by default (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EudraLex Site Suitability Template, version 3.0, September 2023 (mandatory in Latvia)

documents.signature_rule: Signed and dated before CTIS submission by an authorised representative of the healthcare institution or another appropriately authorised person in charge.
documents.content: A separate statement for each Latvian site, uploaded under Suitability of the facilities. Identifies the protocol title and sponsor protocol number; describes facilities, equipment, procedures, staff and expertise; lists off-site institutions performing trial procedures other than laboratories and centrally provided services.

national_fields.v125: Required in Latvia: identify the protocol title and the sponsor protocol number at the start of the statement (the shared form has no protocol-number field).
national_fields.v128: Required in Latvia: list the off-site institutions that perform trial procedures for this site, other than laboratories and centrally provided services; state 'none' if there are none.
national_fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Latvia: keep the Section 3 signature block. An authorised representative of the healthcare institution or another appropriately authorised person in charge signs and dates the statement before CTIS submission. The assistant leaves name, position, date and signature empty for the site.

documents.filled_by: assistant; site fields and the signature block left empty for the site
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa N (Suitability of the facilities). Obligāts: atsevišķa EudraLex veidne katram Latvijas pētījuma centram; Latvijā šīs ES veidnes izmantošana ir obligāta, angļu valodas veidne ir pieņemama. Norādiet protokola nosaukumu un sponsora protokola numuru, aprakstiet telpas, aprīkojumu, procedūras, personālu un kompetenci un uzskaitiet ārpus centra esošās iestādes, kas veic pētījuma procedūras (izņemot laboratorijas un centralizēti sniegtos pakalpojumus). Pirms iesniegšanas CTIS paziņojumu paraksta un datē ārstniecības iestādes pilnvarots pārstāvis vai cita atbilstoši pilnvarota atbildīgā persona; 3. sadaļas paraksta bloku saglabā un atstāj tukšu centram. Centra lauki (nosaukums, galvenais pētnieks, dalībnieku skaits) paliek tukši.

documents.language_rule: No separate Latvian-language rule; the set must be understandable to the assessor.
documents.content: Insurance certificate uploaded under Proof of insurance cover or indemnification, plus the policy terms when the certificate does not contain the conditions needed for assessment. Identifies the specific study; where the format allows, includes the insured participant number and the Latvian site names and addresses. Civil-liability cover for harm to life or health caused by an act or omission of the sponsor, investigator or healthcare institution; Cabinet Regulation No. 192 minimum per participant and per event: 48 Latvian minimum monthly wages (clinical trial) or 12 minimum monthly wages (low-intervention clinical trial), confirmed against the minimum wage in force when the insurance contract is concluded. Issued by the insurer; no separate sponsor signature.

minimum_cover.clinical_trial: 48 Latvian minimum monthly wages per participant per event
minimum_cover.low_intervention_trial: 12 Latvian minimum monthly wages per participant per event
minimum_cover.amount_rule: Monetary amount confirmed against the minimum monthly wage in force when the insurance contract is concluded.

documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa O (Proof of insurance cover or indemnification). Obligāts. Apdrošināšanas sertifikāts un, ja tajā nav novērtēšanai vajadzīgo nosacījumu, polises noteikumi. Jāidentificē konkrētais pētījums; ja formāts ļauj, jānorāda apdrošināto dalībnieku skaits un Latvijas pētījuma centru nosaukumi un adreses. Civiltiesiskās atbildības apdrošināšana par kaitējumu dzīvībai vai veselībai, ko radījusi sponsora, pētnieka vai ārstniecības iestādes darbība vai bezdarbība; MK noteikumi Nr. 192: minimālais limits vienam dalībniekam vienā gadījumā ir 48 minimālās mēneša darba algas (klīniskā izpēte) vai 12 minimālās mēneša darba algas (zemas intervences klīniskā izpēte), summu pārbauda pēc apdrošināšanas līguma noslēgšanas dienā spēkā esošās minimālās algas. Izsniedz apdrošinātājs; sponsora paraksts nav vajadzīgs. Atsevišķa latviešu valodas prasība nav noteikta.

documents.language_rule: No Latvian-language rule for administrative documents; answered in Latvian by default (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EudraLex Compensation for Trial Participants template, version 5, June 2023 (mandatory in Latvia)

documents.content: Uploaded under Financial and other arrangements even if no payment is offered. States reimbursements, loss-of-earnings arrangements, payments or non-monetary benefits, recipients, amounts, justification and conditions; aligned with the participant documents, the draft contract and the site budget (LV-P2).
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa P (Financial and other arrangements). Obligāts, arī tad, ja maksājumi netiek piedāvāti (tad atzīmējiet „Nē” un paskaidrojiet). Latvijā šīs ES veidnes izmantošana ir obligāta. Norādiet izdevumu atlīdzināšanu, negūto ienākumu kompensāciju, naudas vai nenaudas maksājumus, saņēmējus, summas, pamatojumu un nosacījumus. Nepilngadīgajiem, rīcībnespējīgām personām un sievietēm, kas baro bērnu ar krūti, var atlīdzināt tikai izdevumus un negūtos ienākumus, bez finansiāla pamudinājuma. Maksājums nedrīkst būt atkarīgs no pētījuma pabeigšanas tā, ka tas attur no izstāšanās; norādiet, kas pienākas pēc atlases neveiksmes, agrīnas izstāšanās, pētnieka lēmuma pārtraukt dalību vai pētījuma apturēšanas. Formulējumam jāsakrīt ar dalībnieku dokumentiem, līguma projektu un budžetu. Iesniedzot netiek parakstīts.

documents.name_en: Draft site or investigator agreement and trial budget
documents.language_rule: No separate Latvian-language rule for these drafts.
documents.content: A draft contract with each investigator and/or trial site and a draft trial budget showing the allocation for each investigator or site, uploaded under Financial and other arrangements and ready for the initial Part II submission. No executed contract or submission-time signature required, but the draft must be complete enough for ethical review; commercially irrelevant detail may be removed only if the ethics assessment remains possible. Reimbursement wording aligned with P1 and the participant documents (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa P (Financial and other arrangements). Obligāts: līguma projekts ar katru pētnieku un/vai pētījuma centru un pētījuma budžeta projekts, kurā redzams sadalījums katram pētniekam vai centram; jābūt gataviem sākotnējam II daļas iesniegumam. Parakstīts vai noslēgts līgums nav vajadzīgs, bet projektam jābūt pietiekami pilnīgam ētiskajam novērtējumam; komerciāli nebūtisku informāciju drīkst izņemt tikai tad, ja novērtējums joprojām ir iespējams. Atsevišķa latviešu valodas prasība nav noteikta. Atlīdzības formulējumam jāsakrīt ar P1 un dalībnieku dokumentiem.

documents.ctis_title: R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_LV
documents.language_rule: The English EudraLex statement may be used; answered in Latvian by default (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EudraLex statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679, with the Latvian-law confirmation added

documents.content: Sponsor statement uploaded under Compliance with national requirements on data protection, confirming that data will be collected and processed in accordance with the GDPR and Latvian law. No separate national form and no published submission-time signature requirement.

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Required in Latvia: in the answer language, state that the data will also be collected and processed in accordance with Latvian law (the Latvia checklist asks for a statement of compliance with the GDPR and Latvian law; DECISIONS.md D9).

documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa R (Compliance with national requirements on data protection). Obligāts sponsora paziņojums, ka dati tiks vākti un apstrādāti saskaņā ar Vispārīgo datu aizsardzības regulu (VDAR) un Latvijas tiesību aktiem. Var izmantot angļu valodas EudraLex paziņojumu; atsevišķa nacionālā veidlapa nav vajadzīga, un atsevišķa paraksta prasība iesniegšanas brīdī nav publicēta. Pievienojiet teikumu par atbilstību Latvijas tiesību aktiem (national_fields, DECISIONS.md D9). Sponsora atbildīgās personas vārdu un amatu sniedz sponsors; tos neizdomā.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_LV
documents.trigger_text: Biological samples are collected, stored, transferred or retained for future use.
documents.language_rule: The English EudraLex template is recommended; answered in Latvian by default (DECISIONS.md D1).

template.basis: EudraLex Biological Samples Compliance template, 28 January 2022 (recommended in Latvia)

documents.content: Uploaded under Compliance with use of biological samples. Covers sample types and amounts, responsible entity, locations, storage period, transfers, coding, future use, withdrawal handling and destruction or anonymisation, linked to the choices in the participant documents.
documents.drafting_notes_lv: CTIS II daļa, sadaļa S (Compliance with use of biological samples). Nosacīts: ja bioloģiskos paraugus vāc, uzglabā, nodod vai saglabā turpmākai izmantošanai. Latvijā ieteicama angļu valodas EudraLex veidne; paraksts iesniedzot nav noteikts. Aprakstiet paraugu veidus un daudzumu, atbildīgo subjektu, atrašanās vietas, uzglabāšanas laiku, nodošanu, kodēšanu, turpmāku izmantošanu, rīcību piekrišanas atsaukšanas gadījumā un iznīcināšanu vai anonimizēšanu. Saskaņojiet ar attiecīgajām izvēlēm dalībnieku dokumentos un ar sekundārās izmantošanas piekrišanu. Kodētus paraugus nesauciet par anonīmiem.

checklist_mapping_note: One document per item of the Latvia Part II document checklist page (checklist_item 1-13). The page's final submission check is in checklists/part-ii-package.json.

fields.v105: Required in Latvia: in Latvian, state that every advertisement, invitation, social-media item, script, leaflet, poster, video text, doctor letter or other material used in Latvia to recruit or refer potential participants is in Latvian (materials intended for participants and for doctors) and is submitted under Recruitment arrangements as a final blank version, not signed; give the channel and purpose of each item. For healthy volunteers, describe identification, first contact, record access, pre-screening and who approaches volunteers, including any identifiable patient lists or outside pre-screening provider.
fields.v108: Required in Latvia: in Latvian, state that the participant documents are in Latvian and understandable to the intended population; that the participant receives adequate time to consider the information and can ask questions; that the competent adult participant (or the authorised decision-maker) and the person conducting the consent interview sign and date the consent before any trial-specific procedure (the CTIS copy is blank and unsigned) and that a copy of the signed consent documentation is given; that if a participant group cannot understand Latvian, an additional approved language version and consent process is used, never an unapproved ad hoc translation; and that new information that may affect willingness to continue is given promptly and voluntary written consent to continue is obtained.
fields.v110: Required in Latvia when adults unable to consent are included: in Latvian, describe how capacity is assessed, by whom, when it is reassessed and how fluctuating or temporary incapacity is handled; that under the Law on the Rights of Patients the decision-maker for a patient unable to express their wishes and not under a relevant court arrangement is the patient's authorised person, spouse, partner or closest relative, giving written consent, and only if the patient has not previously objected to trial participation; that for a patient under guardianship or trusteeship written consent is given by the lawful representative, or by the guardian together with the patient according to the court-defined restriction of legal capacity; that the site verifies and records the decision-maker's authority before consent and does not enrol while authority is uncertain; that the participant receives information suited to their capacity and an objection (verbal or non-verbal) is respected and cannot be overridden by the representative; and that the participant's own written consent is obtained with the current adult Latvian information as soon as capacity is regained.
fields.v114: Required in Latvia when minors are included: in Latvian, describe the two national pathways: under 14, written consent of the legal representative, with the child informed according to age and maturity and the younger child's own agreement sought where appropriate (a young child's signature never replaces the legal representative's consent); from 14 until the 18th birthday, written consent of both the minor and the legal representative (Cabinet Regulation No. 192; Law on the Rights of Patients). State who qualifies as legal representative under Latvian law, how authority is documented at the site and how shared custody, guardianship, disagreement or missing documentation are handled; do not state a universal two-parent signature rule without a trial-specific legal basis. State that a capable adolescent's refusal means no enrolment and that a younger child's verbal or behavioural objection is taken seriously (Article 32 CTR); that information is given by investigators or team members trained or experienced in working with children; and that consent is renewed when the child reaches 14 (minor's own written consent added) and when the participant reaches 18 (adult consent with the current adult version).
fields.v117: Required in Latvia when an impartial witness may be needed: in Latvian, state that the route is used only when a participant who can consent cannot write (not for a language barrier, which needs information in a language the participant understands and a qualified interpreter, and not instead of a legal representative); how capacity, inability to write, witness impartiality (independent of the trial and of the study team, conflicts checked), accessible information, questions, voluntary agreement and copies are handled; that the person conducting the interview and the witness sign and date, the participant signs if physically able or the approved alternative means is recorded; and that withdrawal does not require a handwritten request.
fields.v121: Required in Latvia when emergency enrolment is used: in Latvian, explain each Article 35 condition for the exact condition and therapeutic window; who confirms eligibility, how prior objections and available representatives are checked, what is documented and how quickly the subsequent-consent team is contacted; that Latvia publishes no separate national emergency-consent form; that subsequent consent is sought without undue delay from the participant if able, otherwise from the legally designated representative, and from the participant directly when capacity is regained; and how refusal and withdrawal are handled for interventions, data and samples.

fields.v125: Required in Latvia: identify the protocol title and the sponsor protocol number at the start of the statement (the shared form has no protocol-number field).
fields.v128: Required in Latvia: list the off-site institutions that perform trial procedures for this site, other than laboratories and centrally provided services; state 'none' if there are none.
fields.n1_issued_by: Required in Latvia: keep the Section 3 signature block. An authorised representative of the healthcare institution or another appropriately authorised person in charge signs and dates the statement before CTIS submission. The assistant leaves name, position, date and signature empty for the site.

fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Required in Latvia: in the answer language, state that the data will also be collected and processed in accordance with Latvian law (the Latvia checklist asks for a statement of compliance with the GDPR and Latvian law; DECISIONS.md D9).

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json.

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, sponsor legal, site). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

participant_templates_missing_note: No Latvian participant templates were supplied (the CTIS_LV folder holds only the seven Part II DOCX files and the variable sheet). Each participant document is drafted from the Latvia guides (drafting_rules, population_sets notes, checklists/participant-documents.json) with styles/base.md and countries/LV/styling.md, or adapted from its reference-package counterpart (based_on), until a Latvian set is supplied and split into templates/participant (DECISIONS.md D14).

population_sets.basis: Latvia patient information and consent guide (standard adult set); no Latvian template supplied.
population_sets.note: Standard adult set in Latvian. Written informed consent of the competent adult; participant and person conducting the interview sign and date; copy given. Also the adult form for re-consent at 18 and after regained capacity.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_screening_<population>_LV_lv
documents.condition: consent.separate_screening: screening involves research procedures or collection of data or samples before main enrolment and the scope is not made clear in the main document (DECISIONS.md D6)

population_sets.note: Mandatory Latvian healthy-volunteer document. States that the trial is research and not intended to treat an illness; screening, confinement, restrictions, samples, reproductive rules, adverse-event care, insurance, incidental findings, simultaneous-participation checks; payments matched to P1 and the site budget. Separate consents for optional genetic work, future use, pregnancy follow-up or recordings. A healthy-volunteer design including minors, adults unable to consent, breastfeeding women or emergency enrolment still needs the relevant variation.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_age 0-13_<population>_LV_lv
documents.condition: the protocol includes children under 14 who can understand the trial

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_age 14-17_<population>_LV_lv
documents.condition: the protocol includes minors aged 14 to 17, or children who can reach 14 during the trial

population_sets.note: Two national age bands: under 14, legal-representative written consent and age-appropriate child information or assent where the child can understand; from 14 to the 18th birthday, written consent of both the minor and the legal representative (coordinated documents or a combined set with separate signature lines, DECISIONS.md D3). Re-consent at 14 with the 14-17 document and at 18 with the adult document (LV-PT-main or LV-PT-healthy).

Both mandatory. Article 31 conditions; decision-maker under the Law on the Rights of Patients with verified authority; participant information suited to their ability (simplified sheet, visual aid, supported discussion or another approved format); objection respected. A capacity-assessment form is added only when the protocol uses a structured assessment (consent.capacity_assessment_form). Adult form (LV-PT-main) when capacity is regained.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency initial information_<population>_LV_lv
documents.condition: a representative may become available within the therapeutic window (DECISIONS.md D10)

population_sets.note: Article 35 pathway; Latvia has no separate national emergency-consent form. Full subsequent information and consent for the participant once able and for the legally designated representative while the participant remains unable; optional continued follow-up or data and sample choices not covered by the emergency intervention are separate choices (LV-PT-secondary where they are future use). The documents explain what already occurred under the emergency pathway.

Standard Latvian information with the alternative consent method and a witness statement block (participant and document version, reason, alternative means, accurate explanation and apparent understanding, consent freely given, witness name, role or relationship, signature and date); separate interpreter attestation if an interpreter is involved. Only for a participant who can consent but cannot write.
Separate or renewed consent when planned collection, medical-record access, long-term follow-up or infant data are not adequately covered by the main consent (DECISIONS.md D13).

Mandatory when partner data will be collected: the pregnant partner's own informed consent before identifiable pregnancy, medical-record, outcome or infant information is collected; the enrolled participant cannot consent for her. Limited to the activities that apply to her; she is not described as a trial participant.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_infant follow-up_LV_lv
documents.condition: separate authority or information is needed for identifiable infant medical information (DECISIONS.md D17)

population_sets.note: Authority and consent of the child's legal representative under Latvian law for identifiable infant medical information; otherwise a clearly separated infant section with the legal-representative signature in the pregnancy or partner document.

Separate section or document (DECISIONS.md D11); optional, unticked choice or another active decision, separate choices where a combined answer would mislead. Minors: legal-representative permission, child involved by age and maturity, and a new decision at adulthood. Adults unable to consent: representative's authority confirmed; revisited if capacity is regained.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which documents a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents. Every template is "missing": none was supplied.

population_rules.authority: ZVA (State Agency of Medicines of Latvia) and the medicinal-product clinical-trial ethics committee ZVA assigns; Cabinet Regulation No. 192 (26 March 2024), paragraphs 28 to 34 and 46 to 47; Law on the Rights of Patients, Sections 7, 10, 11 and 13; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; Overview Part II Requirements, Latvian Local Requirements, version 2.0 (4 February 2025); as recorded in the Latvia guides reviewed 23 September 2026.
population_rules.template_status: missing: no Latvian participant templates were supplied. Every template id below is a planned id from participant_templates_missing, with no file ("template": "missing" in population_sets).

age_bands.basis: Latvia minors guide: under 14, legal-representative written consent; child informed according to age and maturity; child information or assent document when the child can understand; the younger child's own agreement recommended depending on maturity.

Latvia minors guide and Part II checklist: from age 14 until the 18th birthday the minor's own written consent and the legal representative's written consent are both required (Cabinet Regulation No. 192, paragraphs 28 to 30; Law on the Rights of Patients).

minors.band_rule: The two national bands are fixed by Latvian law (written consent of the minor from 14). The under-14 child document may be split further by maturity when the protocol's age range is wide (DECISIONS.md D4).
minors.band_conflict: None: no Latvian templates were supplied, and the hub, Part II checklist, minors guide and QC checklist all use 0 to 13 and 14 to 17.
minors.representatives: The legal representative recognised under Latvian law gives written consent; authority is documented at the site. The national rule uses the singular legal representative and does not require two parental signatures; no universal two-parent rule without a trial-specific legal basis. Shared custody, guardianship, disagreement or unavailable documentation handled by a site process planned before recruitment (DECISIONS.md D5).
minors.assent_dissent: Minor involved according to age and maturity; a capable adolescent's refusal means no enrolment; a younger child's verbal or behavioural objection is taken seriously; the explicit wish of a minor able to form an opinion to refuse or withdraw is respected (Article 32). Rules for necessary medical treatment do not remove these research protections. A young child's signature never substitutes for the legal representative's consent; an assent form must not imply legal consent.
minors.adolescent_information: Direct and understandable, not a copy of the parent document with minor wording changes; confidentiality boundaries, pregnancy and contraception where relevant, data and sample use, withdrawal and contacts.
minors.reconsent_at_14: LV-PT-age-14-17: the minor's written consent for continued participation alongside the legal representative's consent.
minors.reconsent_at_18: LV-PT-main or LV-PT-healthy (current adult version) as soon as possible; earlier representative permission is not adult consent.
minors.payment: Reimbursement of expenses and loss of earnings only; no financial inducement (CTR).

adults_without_capacity.decision_makers: Patient unable to express wishes and not under a relevant court arrangement: the patient's authorised person, spouse, partner or closest relative (Law on the Rights of Patients), in writing, and only if the patient did not previously object. Under guardianship or trusteeship: the lawful representative, or the guardian together with the patient according to the court-defined restriction of legal capacity. Lawful person confirmed for the individual case; no generic hierarchy copied into the consent form; no enrolment while authority is uncertain.
adults_without_capacity.note: Not used merely because of a diagnosis, disability, low literacy or temporary communication difficulty; capacity assessed for the specific decision, with support or an impartial witness where the person can consent. Objection, including non-verbal resistance, respected and not overridden by the representative. Own written consent with LV-PT-main when capacity is regained; optional data and sample choices revisited.

emergency.note: All Article 35 conditions; no Latvian national emergency-consent form. Prior objection excludes the route. Subsequent consent without undue delay; the participant's own consent when capacity returns; no promise of automatic deletion of legally required safety or trial records.

impartial_witness.note: Participant can consent but cannot write; at least one impartial witness present; not for a language barrier and not instead of a legal representative. The witnessed consent remains the record if the barrier resolves.

pregnancy.participant: LV-PT-pregnancy only when the main consent does not adequately cover the planned collection, medical-record access, long-term follow-up or infant data.
pregnancy.partner: LV-PT-pregnant-partner whenever partner data are collected.
pregnancy.infant: LV-PT-infant or a clearly separated infant section with the legal-representative signature (DECISIONS.md D17).

secondary_use.note: Separate section or document; refusing does not prevent participation or affect care; withdrawal distinguishes stopping new use, destroying remaining samples where feasible, retaining results already generated, use after irreversible anonymisation and legally required retention.

population_rules.non_latvian_speakers: If a participant group cannot understand Latvian, plan a suitable additional language version and consent process (study fact population.non_latvian_speakers); no unapproved ad hoc translation. The guides do not require or mention Russian-language documents (DECISIONS.md D2).
population_rules.shareable_note: One shared document for several populations only when nothing in it would differ; a secondary-use document for minors or represented adults needs representative and age-appropriate elements and is not shared with capable adults. Agree with the user (DECISIONS.md D16).
separate_document_rules: A separate document or clearly tailored version for each population and consent pathway in the protocol (Latvia patient information and consent guide).
Pregnant-participant and pregnant-partner pathways are separate because the partner is a separate data subject.
Main-trial consent is separate from optional future research, optional biopsies, recordings, genetic analysis beyond the trial purpose and re-contact.

Healthy volunteers: separate consents for optional genetic work, future use, pregnancy follow-up, recordings or other activities not necessary for the main trial; screening consent scope made clear or a separate screening consent.
Adults unable to consent: separate legal-representative document and participant information.
Minors 14 to 17: the minor's own consent and the legal representative's consent, as coordinated documents or a combined set with separate signature lines.
Re-consent: at 14 (minor's own consent), at 18 and when capacity is regained (participant's own adult consent), and after new information that may affect willingness to continue.

drafting_rules: Participant documents are in Latvian, concise and understandable to the intended population; plain Latvian, short sentences, familiar terms, abbreviations defined at first use, technical detail that does not help the decision removed.

Document identity: descriptive title, version and date, sponsor protocol number, EU CT number, study-centre name and address, data-controller identity, and contact details for ZVA, the assigned ethics committee and the Data State Inspectorate (Latvia national overview). Controlled fields only where the final site or committee detail is not yet known; completed before use.

The information allows a reasonable person to decide without the protocol: title, purpose, research nature, sponsor, responsible site; why invited and expected number of participants; groups, randomisation, placebo, blinding and chance of assignment; visits, procedures, samples, questionnaires, recordings and total period; risks, burdens, side effects, reproductive risks and risk control; expected benefit (clear statement when none is expected); alternatives and usual care; pregnancy testing, contraception, breastfeeding and pregnancy reporting; sample purpose, destination, storage, coding, transfer and future use; personal-data use, recipients, transfers, retention, safeguards and rights; expenses, payments, free trial medicines and procedures, insurance and injury arrangements; voluntariness, withdrawal and its consequences, treatment after withdrawal; new information; contacts for trial questions, urgent medical issues, participant rights, privacy, ZVA and the ethics committee.

Latvian rules: the investigational medicinal products, the devices needed to administer them and the other medicines, devices and examinations specified in the protocol are provided free of charge; state this where it helps the participant understand costs, consistently with the payment and insurance sections.

Consent statements are specific; the mandatory agreement to participate is separate from optional activities; refusing an optional choice does not block participation unless the protocol makes the activity scientifically necessary and the information explains this; no bundling of trial participation with broad unrelated data or sample use.

Signatures at consent: the participant or authorised decision-maker and the person conducting the consent interview sign and date; impartial witness only in the witness pathway; minors from 14 sign their own consent; copy of the signed documentation given. Blank CTIS copies carry no signatures or personal data.

Withdrawal from participation is explained separately from withdrawal of optional future-use permission; what happens to data and samples already collected is stated without promising deletion where lawfully retained trial records must remain.

Privacy: controller and processors identified without confusing sponsor, site and investigator roles; data categories, purposes, recipients, retention, international transfers, safeguards and rights consistent with R1; Data State Inspectorate contact; direct access to medical records for authorised persons explained; consent to participate is not presented as the sole legal basis for every processing activity; privacy contacts separate from medical-emergency contacts.

Samples: coded or pseudonymised samples and data are never called anonymous; genetic analysis and return of individual or incidental findings stated; withdrawal wording aligned with S1, the protocol and the sample-management plan.
Reimbursement and payment wording matches P1 and the draft site budget; injury and insurance wording matches the Latvia-compliant insurance evidence (Cabinet Regulation No. 192).

Healthy volunteers: payment not contingent on finishing in a way that discourages withdrawal; state what is payable after screen failure, early withdrawal, investigator discontinuation or trial suspension. Minors, incapacitated participants and breastfeeding women receive only reimbursement of expenses and loss of earnings.

Changes during the trial: new information that may affect willingness to continue is given promptly and voluntary written consent to continue is obtained; a material change goes through a substantial modification before implementation unless an urgent safety measure applies.
Final native-language proofread after all content changes; do not rely only on back-translation or automated checks.

Participant templates were not supplied; where a reference document or a later template is used, its instructions ([square-bracket] notes, italic notes, '...........' gaps) and the Part II form instructions (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: ...] labels) are drafting instructions; none may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.latvia_note: Use the CTCG pattern; the Latvia guides use descriptive names and give no national naming instruction beyond identifying the document type in the participant-document filename (adult, legal representative, 0 to 13 years, 14 to 17 years). _LV_lv on participant-facing documents (_LV_ru or another code for an additional language version), _LV on O1, P1, R1 and S1. P2 contract and budget titles and the R2 endpoint-translation title are proposed (DECISIONS.md D7, D8).

sources_note: All Latvia guides reviewed 23 September 2026, read 27 November 2026 (11 pages). '#n' after LV-PII-CHECKLIST is the item number on that page. Supplied: CTIS_LV Part II DOCX set and Latvian variable sheet (compared with the shared forms); no Latvian participant templates.
